definitions.explanation: People who share the same status, characteristic, or situation. Often used as a suffix meaning 'among ~' or '~ with each other'.

examples.japanese: ⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧{同士|どうし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会話|かいわ}→会話：01271_kaiwa⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧{同士|どうし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{助|たす}け{合|あ}おう→助け合う：04654_tasukeau⟧。
examples.english: Let's help each other as comrades.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧{同士|どうし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went on a trip with friends.
examples.notes: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧{同士|どうし} = among friends

notes:
USAGE: {同士|どうし} is often used as a suffix attached to nouns to mean 'among ~' or '~ with each other'. It emphasizes shared membership in a group.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜{同士|どうし} (among ~, between ~)
- ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧{同士|どうし} (among friends)
- ⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧{同士|どうし} (among companions)
- ⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧/⟦{女|おんな}→女：00559_onna⟧{同士|どうし} (among men/women)
- ⟦{恋人|こいびと}→恋人：02724_koibito⟧{同士|どうし} (as lovers)
- ⟦{親子|おやこ}→親子：10430_oyako⟧{同士|どうし} (between parent and child)

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{動詞|どうし}→動詞：03472_doushi⟧ (verb) - same reading, different meaning

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧ (companion, colleague)
- ⟦{同僚|どうりょう}→同僚：01023_douryou⟧ (colleague at work)
- ⟦お{互|たが}い→お互い：00336_otagai⟧ (each other, mutual)
